verification.notes: Confirmed: C117 4630/1777/1432/2699, 470 l (ADAC; facelift 4640 mm). X117 4630/1777/1435/2699, 495/1354 l. X118 4688/1830/2729, 505 l, 1442 mm height (mbpassion launch report; some sources 1433), 1370 folded. S212 4895/1854/2874, 695/1950 l; E 300 BlueTEC HYBRID 650/1905 l (autoplenum, autoscout24). S211 4850/1496/2854, 690/1950 l (auto-data, aerzteblatt). Unresolved: S212 height - angurten.de lists 1515 mm vs 1512 mm claimed from Daimler press; not changed since manufacturer figure could not be seen. X118 CLA 250 e 2020 value and C117 CLA 45 AMG trunk not found (other C117 4MATIC variants 470 l). X118 width 1830 confirmed by test report; S211 width 1822 not independently re-confirmed. 12 WebSearch calls used.
